### Qualified current-revision assessment

The readiness helper distinguishes worker startup from usable provisioning, validates the run and payload identities before accepting a ready marker, and keeps startup and trust-preparation deadlines separate. Premature scheduled-task completion is reported with its result, while helper exceptions reach callers without being replaced by the later defensive postcondition. The CI caller separately validates the protected ownership marker before trusting provisioning.

The current review established no additional actionable defect in these changes. The repeated readiness check and local phase allowlist are optional simplification/allocation concerns, not demonstrated correctness failures.

**Validation scope:** All eight changed files and the relevant callers were read; 211 exact-revision focused source/fixture checks passed. These checks do not execute privileged provisioning, Hyper-V/Sandbox, the real VM image or interactive input. This is a qualified source assessment, not an unconditional approval or VM signoff.
